verses.text: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not only I, but everyone who knows the truth—
because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever:
Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father’s Son, will be with us in truth and love.
I was overjoyed to find some of your children living by the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
And now, dear lady, I’m asking you—not as though I were writing a new command, but the one we’ve had from the beginning—that we love one another.
This is love: that we live by his commands. This is the command you heard from the beginning: live in love.
Many deceivers have gone out into the world. They don’t acknowledge Jesus Christ as coming in the flesh. Anyone like that is a deceiver and the antichrist.
Watch yourselves, so you don’t lose what we’ve worked for, but may receive a full reward.
Anyone who goes beyond Christ’s teaching and doesn’t remain in it doesn’t have God. Whoever remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you without this teaching, don’t welcome them into your home or give them your support,
because whoever supports them shares in their evil work.
I have much more to write to you, but I don’t want to do it with paper and ink. I hope to visit you and talk face to face, so our joy may be complete.
The children of your chosen sister send greetings.
